courseraUpdateSubtitle: We want to share an important update about Coursera access through Kiron.
courseraUpdateDescription:
Coursera has been a long-standing and incredibly valuable partner to Kiron. Over the past 11 years, hundreds of thousands of Kiron learners have been able to access high-quality courses through Coursera, thanks to licences generously provided through the Coursera for Social Impact programme.

Coursera has recently changed the conditions of this programme worldwide, and access is now limited to one year per learner. As Kiron receives Coursera licences through this programme, we need to follow these new conditions.

We are very grateful that Coursera continues to make a year of learning available to Kiron learners, and we really encourage everyone with an active licence to make the most of this opportunity.

We also know that this news may be disappointing, particularly for learners who have been using Coursera through Kiron for several years. Unfortunately, once the one-year access period has ended, Kiron is not able to extend or reactivate individual licences. As a small nonprofit organisation, we are also not able to fund individual Coursera Plus subscriptions or manage individual Financial Aid applications.

If you would like to continue learning with Coursera after your Kiron access ends, you can explore Coursera’s own subscription and Financial Aid options directly through their platform.

We are sorry for the disappointment this change may cause, and we are very grateful to Coursera for the learning opportunities they have made available to our community over so many years.
